Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the deep dive into Acme's realtime analytics use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

- Scope: validate latency and cost at 5–10 qps with the 4k-token models for your customer-facing summarization pipeline.
- Success criteria: median 95th-percentile latency under 250ms and cost/unit < $0.005 per generated token.
- PoC deliverables: (1) sandbox instance with sample dataset, (2) baseline perf run + report, (3) recommendations for batching/quantization.

Immediate next steps I can own:
1) I'll send a short onboarding checklist with the minimal infra creds we need and a sample dataset.
2) Aditya (cc) will be available to help with sandbox provisioning and any network questions.
3) Can we tentatively schedule a 30-min kickoff for next Wed 3/4 or Thu 3/5?

If those dates don't work, send one or two options and we'll lock it. I'll attach the onboarding checklist and the draft SOW for your review.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
